apps.name: DuckTV: IPTV & M3U Player
apps.description:
DuckTV is a player. It does not provide, sell, or host any TV channels, streams, or IPTV subscriptions, and it comes with no content of any kind. There is nothing to watch until you sign in with an account you already have from a provider you already pay. You bring the account; DuckTV brings the interface.

If you already have an Xtream Codes or M3U login from your provider, type the server address, your username and your password, and DuckTV turns that line into a proper TV app on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad.

WHAT DUCKTV IS NOT
• Not a channel provider. No channels, no playlists, no streams are bundled.
• Not a subscription service for television. There is no signup, no provider directory, and no way to buy TV inside the app.
• Not tied to any one company. Any standards-compliant Xtream Codes panel works.

WHAT YOU GET

Live TV that behaves like television
One playback engine, so changing channel is instant instead of a reload. Slide-in channel and category lists, a now/next info bar, favourites, recent channels, and a full time-grid guide with a live now-line when your provider sends EPG data. Prefer a better guide than your panel ships? Point DuckTV at your own XMLTV URL instead.

Movies and Series
Your provider's on-demand catalogue in a poster grid with categories, sorting and search. Playback remembers where you stopped, and picks the next episode up automatically.

Search
One field across live channels, movies and series.

Sports
Live scores, schedules and standings for NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, college football and basketball, major soccer competitions and Formula 1 — pulled from public sports data, not from your provider. A spoiler shield hides scores until you ask for them. If you play Yahoo Fantasy, you can connect your Yahoo account (an integration Yahoo has approved) to see your team, your matchup and your players alongside the game.

Multiview
Watch several channels at once in a grid on Apple TV, with audio following the tile you pick.

DVR
Record live TV to the device and play it back from the DVR tab.

Parental controls
A PIN that hides categories you choose, and hides adult categories across Live TV, Movies and Series until the PIN is entered. Because the channels come from your provider and not from us, DuckTV cannot know or filter what is on them — these controls, and your provider's own account settings, are how you decide what is reachable on your device.

A player that actually plays things
DuckTV uses VLC (libVLC) as well as Apple's own engine, so MPEG-TS, HEVC and MKV streams that AVPlayer refuses simply play. Buffer size, hardware decoding and stream format are yours to tune, and an optional stats overlay shows bitrate, resolution and frame rate while you watch.

Built for the remote and for the phone
The Apple TV app is built around the focus engine and the Siri Remote. The iPhone and iPad app is a real touch app — not a stretched TV layout — with Picture in Picture for on-demand playback and background audio.

PRIVACY
Your server address, username and password are stored on your device in the keychain and sent only to your provider. They are never sent to us. There are no ads, no ad identifiers and no third-party tracking SDKs. Anonymous diagnostics can be switched off entirely in Settings → Privacy. Yahoo Fantasy and DuckTrack only do anything if you connect them yourself.

ONE MORE TIME, BECAUSE IT MATTERS
DuckTV has no relationship with any IPTV provider and does not recommend, endorse or resell one. What you watch, and whether you have the right to watch it, is between you and whoever you get your line from. Use DuckTV only with content you are authorised to access.

Requires an Apple TV, iPhone or iPad running tvOS/iOS 17 or later, an internet connection, and your own Xtream Codes or M3U account from a provider.

YOUR TV, ANYWHERE, WITHOUT LIMITS

IP Television is not just a player: it is today's television. Add your own IPTV playlists (M3U8 or Xtream Codes) and the app turns them into a complete TV experience on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. Handle huge numbers of channels, on-demand movies and series and live sport with the smoothness of real TV, with Replay AI on iPhone and iPad to analyse sports plays. The content is yours: the app is the most advanced way to enjoy it.

IP Television is a player: it does not provide or include any channel, movie or content. All content comes exclusively from the personal playlists you add.

NEW: REPLAY AI - THE AI-POWERED REPLAY

In the Replay AI studio on iPhone and iPad, choose a frame and the key moments of the play. Read the summary, the technical explanation and what the images show (or don't), in the app's language.

- Works with football, tennis, Formula 1, MotoGP and basketball
- Choose the tone of the answer: technical, fan or ironic
- Share the analysis with one tap, even as a WhatsApp comment
- Available on live sports channels

Replay AI requires a monthly or yearly subscription. A free 3-day trial is offered when available for your account.

WHAT TO WATCH? AND SIRI

Not sure what to watch? Ask in your own words, like "a highly rated thriller" or "a science-fiction series": the app suggests the right titles from your playlist and the programmes on air, without the ones you've already seen. With Siri your voice is enough: watch a channel, resume your last title or find out what's on tonight. The same commands are in Shortcuts and Spotlight.

PLAYS ON WHILE OTHERS RELOAD
Neverlag builds a reserve of the programme you’re watching – up to 45 seconds by default, adjustable up to 90 seconds. When your provider stalls, playback continues from that reserve while Neverlag reconnects in the background and picks up where the picture left off. The quality panel shows reserve, delay behind live, bitrate and picture.

SWITCHES THE SOURCE INSTEAD OF FREEZING
If the picture freezes or a channel fails at the provider, Neverlag takes another source of the same channel or the same channel from another of your lists. One line tells you what happened, one button takes you back. If 4K keeps stalling, Neverlag drops to Full HD and tells you.

YOUR IPHONE AS THE REMOTE
With Neverlag on iPhone or iPad you control Neverlag on Apple TV: a D-pad like the Siri Remote or a touch area, your channels as tiles, pause/live and 30 seconds back. From iOS 18 also from Control Center, without opening the app. Several Apple TVs at home: pair, name, switch.

PROFILES FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY

TV GUIDE, ARCHIVE AND CATCH-UP
A TV guide grid from your provider’s EPG data (XMLTV). Missed shows in the archive, by show or by channel, when your provider offers catch-up. Neverlag tags programmes like football, news or kids automatically. Pause, rewind and record live TV – stored locally on Mac, iPhone and iPad, on your network storage on Apple TV.

BIG LISTS UNDER CONTROL
Groups, favorites, search and a jump bar that gets you to the right letter even with more than 10,000 channels. Movies and series with resume, when your provider includes them. 4K playback; on Mac, Neverlag matches the display’s refresh rate to the programme in full screen.

NEW DESIGN
A calm, dark interface on every device. Settings in clear sections, with search and an explanation for every option.

SET UP APPLE TV WITHOUT TYPING
No server addresses typed with the remote: Apple TV shows a code, your iPhone or Mac sends the login over your home network.

Start it on your phone. Throw it to your TV. RunTV is the IPTV player that follows you across every screen: watch a channel on your iPhone or iPad, send it to your TV with one tap, run up to 4 channels at once on the big screen, and it comes back to your hand when you get up.

MULTIVIEW IN YOUR HAND
Two streams at once on iPhone, up to four on iPad.

Drag a tile to swap places, or tap one to take it full screen and swipe to move between your streams.
Each stream gets its own provider login, so they do not compete for a connection.

MULTIVIEW, THROWN FROM YOUR PHONE
One tap sends any stream to your TV. Up to 4 streams on one TV with 8 layouts: full screen, split screen side by side, big and small, picture in picture (PiP), 3-up, and 2x2 grid.
Drag a stream on your phone to instantly swap zones on the TV.
Pick which stream has the audio with one tap.
Get up and leave, and the stream follows you back to your phone.

ALL YOUR SOURCES IN ONE PLACE
Channels, movies, and series from every source you added, in one searchable list.
The same title from more than one source appears once, and you choose which source to play it from.
Posters, categories, and a full episode picker with seasons and automatic resume.
Continue Watching and Favorites, one tap away.

A REAL PROGRAM GUIDE
Days back and forward, filtered by channel or category, with program search.

BUILT FOR SPORTS FANS
Live scores and schedules for the games you follow, right while you watch.

WORKS WITH YOUR IPTV PROVIDER
M3U and M3U8 playlists, and Xtream Codes logins.

FREE AND PRIVATE

apps.name: SafeIPTV - Secure IPTV Player
apps.description:
Your streams. Your privacy. No ads.

Want to enjoy your channels, movies, and series without ad banners, without tracking, and without an app quietly logging everything in the background? Then SafeIPTV is the player for you: built natively for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV, connected directly to your own IPTV provider, and designed so your data stays with you.

PRIVACY WITHOUT COMPROMISE

• No data collection: no tracking, no analytics, no user profiles. We don't run any server that stores your catalog, history, or usage data. What's never collected can never fall into the wrong hands.
• No account needed: no sign-up, no email address, no tracking ID.
• Everything stays local: SafeIPTV keeps your favorites, history, playback progress, and settings on your device only, never with us.
• Passwords locked down: encrypted in the iOS, macOS, and tvOS Keychain, tied to your device, and never stored in plain text. A pasted playlist, including its stream addresses, stays on your device only.
• No middleman: SafeIPTV connects directly to your provider. No proxy, no detour through our servers, and no storing of your device's MAC address.
• You're in control: clear your history anytime. When you remove an account, SafeIPTV also deletes its password, pasted playlist, catalog, favorites, and history from your device.

That's why our App Privacy label reads: Data Not Collected. Developed in Germany, under EU data protection law.

AD-FREE, UNDISTURBED VIEWING

• Truly ad-free: no banners, no pop-ups, no commercials before your stream. SafeIPTV never inserts ads anywhere, not in the interface and not in the player.
• No hidden costs: no subscription, no premium tier. After a 7-day free trial, a single in-app purchase unlocks every feature for good.
• No distractions: no push notifications, no ad SDKs running in the background. Just you and your shows.

TRY FIRST. BUY ONCE. FOUR DEVICES.

Try SafeIPTV with your own provider for 7 days. The trial simply ends; you're never charged automatically. Like it? Unlock the full version once and use it on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV. On the big screen, you control everything from the couch with the Siri Remote, and on the Mac with a keyboard and mouse. And with Apple's Family Sharing, your family can use the full version too, without buying it again.

MORE FEATURES

• Quick setup: enter your server URL, username, and password, or simply paste your provider's M3U link. On iPhone, iPad, and Mac you can also create your own playlist by pasting M3U entries directly. The app checks them right away and points out lines with errors.
• Live TV, movies, and series in a clean catalog. You search the current category or the whole catalog, sort by name, date, or rating, and save favorites for titles and entire categories. Everything stays on your device.
• Pick up right where you left off, plus “Recently Watched” and “Recently Added”
• Program guide (EPG) with live preview and a time offset for each account
• Choose the audio track, subtitles, and aspect ratio right in the player
• Manage multiple IPTV accounts and switch between them quickly
• Playback built on VLC, with advanced settings for power users: buffering, hardware decoding, and automatic reconnection when a live stream stalls

GOOD TO KNOW

SafeIPTV is a player only and does not include any playlists, channels, movies, series, or other content. The purchase price covers the software only, not IPTV content or a provider subscription. You need your own lawful access from a provider that supports Xtream Codes or M3U playlists. We are not a broadcaster and do not provide any sources.

apps.releaseNotes:
This version finally answers "I don't know what to watch", lets you hide and pin categories, adds a notification feed and makes titles readable. The home screen also loads much faster on large catalogues.

SURPRISE ME
• New: one tap suggests a movie or series to watch, with its poster, title, year, genres and why this one. From there, open its page or draw again.
• Suggestions start from what you actually watch: your genres, what you finished rather than abandoned, and the best rated titles in your catalogue. Part of every draw deliberately steps outside your habits, and says so.
• It doesn't repeat itself from one evening to the next and never suggests a movie you've already seen.
• On iPad in landscape, it opens in a large window with the synopsis.
• It also shows up when you're stuck: when nothing is in progress, when a search finds nothing, and at the bottom of the home screen.
• Spektra Pro only.

CATEGORIES
• New: hide the provider folders you never use in Live TV, Movies and Series. Search and "Hide all" let you keep just a few out of hundreds.
• Pin your favourite folders: they stay at the top of Live TV, Movies, Series and the TV guide.
• Available from "Manage categories", at the top of each category list, and in Settings.
• Your favourites are kept, even if their category is hidden.

NOTIFICATIONS
• New: a bell in the header gathers Spektra announcements and your provider line status: subscription expiring, account disabled, or all your connections in use — the outage that looks like a broken app.

TITLES
• "Fire Force 2019 FHD MULTI (H.265)" now shows as "Fire Force 2019".
• Language tags such as VF, VOST and SUBFRENCH are recognised, so missing posters, synopses and cast come back.
• Real names are kept: "The Office (US)", "Dune (Part Two)".

SPEED
• The home screen builds about 5 times faster on large catalogues: 1.5 s instead of 8.4 s for 76,000 movies and 15,000 series.
• Faster launch, and syncing your data no longer delays it.

FIXES
• A catalogue stuck while loading no longer forces a reinstall: the screen offers to retry, edit the source or sign out.
• A version check could lock the app behind an update message that couldn't be closed. Fixed.
• Favourites: the count now matches the grid, and titles removed by your provider appear greyed out so you can remove them.

One sidebar, one swipe away, with every section of your playlist in it. No nested menus, no settings maze, no waiting for screens to draw. Yagi is a native app written for iOS 26 and macOS 26, with a Liquid Glass interface that feels like it came with the device.

PICKS UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Start a movie on the Mac, finish it on the iPad. Favorites, playlist layout, reminders and settings sync through iCloud with nothing to configure. Hand a channel from your iPhone to your Mac with Handoff, or send it to the big screen with AirPlay.

KEEPS PLAYING WHEN STREAMS STRUGGLE
Streams hang, servers hiccup, and most apps leave you staring at a black screen. Yagi reconnects on its own and keeps you posted while it does, so you never have to switch channels by hand just to get the picture back.

EVERYTHING YOU EXPECT, DONE WELL
• Xtream and M3U playlists, with Live TV, Movies and TV Shows in their own sections
• A TV guide with what's on now and next, and reminders that notify you before a program starts
• Favorites for the channels and shows you come back to

• Downloads for offline viewing of movies and episodes

• Picture in Picture on every device

• Playlists refresh themselves daily, so new channels just appear

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Yagi collects no data. Your playlists and credentials stay on your devices and in your own iCloud account.

Try it free, then choose the plan that suits you. Feature requests and bug reports shape every update, so tell us what you need.

Disclaimer: The developer does not provide, include, supply, or host any live TV channels, movies, or TV shows whatsoever. You are solely responsible for acquiring all playlists through legitimate sources and ensuring full compliance with applicable copyright and licensing laws.

Download content and watch without an internet connection.

Add and manage unlimited playlists in Xtream API and M3U formats.
